name: @quasar/testing
description: Monorepo for test harness integration in Quasar Framework 1.0 projects.
author: Daniel Thompson-Yvetot

@quasar/app-vite: app-vite resolves packages starting from the parent of the app dir (mlly resolvePathSync gets the dir without a trailing slash).
A root-hoisted copy would shadow the version each package or test app expects.
The nohoist keeps every @quasar/app-vite in its own package's node_modules.
vite-plugin-istanbul: The CLI loads AE scripts from the workspace, so the cypress AE's import of vite-plugin-istanbul resolves here instead of in the test app.
The plugin imports its vite peer from its own location, so both must sit inside the package's node_modules.
